prompts.ordinary: Review this same video again and independently determine the start and end of the event requested by the original query. A previous proposal was {start:.2f} to {end:.2f} seconds. Keep that proposal if it is accurate; otherwise correct it. Use the original query and visible video, and return the same required answer/start/end format.
prompts.evidence: Review this same video again to verify the temporal evidence for the event requested by the original query. A previous proposal was {start:.2f} to {end:.2f} seconds. In <think>, cite displayed video timestamp labels and briefly describe the visible action at its beginning and end, checking the neighboring observations before and after it. Distinguish the actual requested action from preparation, merely holding its object, and subsequent activities. Determine an interval supported by those observations. Keep the proposal if supported; otherwise correct it. Do not infer an action merely from the scene or objects. Return the same required answer/start/end format.

freeze: Original query, chosen top1 video, original verification decision, pixels, source timestamps and checkpoint. Only temporal post-processing differs.
budget: ordinary and evidence: at most one extra VLM call each, identical visual inputs, same 1024 generation cap; report actual text/output token costs separately.
fallback: If baseline is not matched or lacks a valid span: no revision. If revision is not matched, invalid or length-capped: keep baseline span. Verification/ranking never overwritten.
evaluation_scope: Conditional correct-initial-video localization probe, not full T=2/N=8 VCMR. Original verification is frozen after initial generation; no SQR is invoked.
holdout_limit: Video-disjoint split within training data; the released checkpoint may have trained on these videos. Not an unseen-video benchmark.
